metadata.description: Fine Enterprises warehouse — F4 RL routing graph (v2, walkway-based)
metadata.scale: warehouse 40 m x 30 m on an 860x780 px canvas (0.0465 m/px across, 0.0385 m/px down)
metadata.route_rule: Every pick tour starts at DEPOT and returns to DEPOT (handover to checkers).

inactive_nodes.DOOR_2F: Door to 2nd floor (TF, 2F, AA-AF) - unused while those sections are excluded

metadata.node_meaning: A place a picker can stand. pick_slots = slots reachable without walking.

edge_types.walk: Walking along a ground-floor walkway between neighbouring stand-points (m)
edge_types.stair: Staircase ground <-> mezzanine (3.5 m per trip, effort factor 1.0)

assumptions: A1: Column 1 of each rack is at the end nearest the main cross aisle (south end in the top cluster, north end in the bottom cluster). Horizontal racks (J, K, Z) start at the west/left end.
A2: G-25..G-30 sit against the left wall facing G-19..G-24 across walkway W5 (as on the v3 map). G-30 exists in the stock file.
A3: B-36 exists in the stock file (15 SKUs) although B was described as 1-35; it is kept as the bottom of column 18.

A4: Mezzanine walkways are approximate straight paths from the stair landing. The SC1 and SC2 mezzanines are one connected deck (joined over G-1..G-12), so every mezzanine location in that area can be reached from either staircase and the router uses whichever is shorter. SC3 leads only to W, plus X-5, which can be picked from the W mezzanine as well as from the SC1 side (Sithija, 2026-10-18).
A5: T/U top row, T-7/T-8, U-7..U-10 and X-4 are on the mezzanine via SC2.

A6: F sits on top of E as two racks: F-1..F-22 directly above E (levels 3-4) and F-23..F-44 above that (levels 5-6); each runs the full length of E, column 1 at the main-aisle end. F-25 and F-29 have no stock.
A7: H-1..H-10 are on a mezzanine over G-1..G-12; its walkway runs along the west side of H (above walkway W6) from the SC1 landing down to the SC2 deck, column 1 at the main-aisle end.
A8: O-13..O-17 run along the top wall from above the X-3 island to the right wall, picked from NX; O-13/O-14 at the left end by the 2nd-floor door.
